This is a well-specified generative task with clear completion criteria: a 300-character answer, no rambling. While both models are capable here (Lapwing actually has the highest Creative Generation eval at 82.7), the request is tightly constrained — bounded length, explicit instruction to stay concise — which fits Lapwing's documented preference for well-specified tasks with clear completion criteria.

That said, the capability difference is small and within typical variance, so this was a close call. Lapwing's slightly higher Arena-Hard score and its self-reported comfort with tightly-scoped, constraint-driven tasks tipped it. There's no harm-adjacent content here, so Whimbrel's harm-aversion profile wasn't a deciding factor either way.
